Maya: quick brain dump 1: propose an "activation ladder" (tiny state machine) for all weight sources so workers have predictable semantics across safetensors, mmap, gz bundles, manifestless. goal: single surface, tiny adapters.

Liam: what are the ladder rungs?

Maya: draft: RESOLVE -> HEADER_SCAN -> INDEX_FASTPATH -> PREFIX_STREAM -> CHUNK_APPLY -> KVCACHE_HYDRATE -> CHUNK_VERIFY -> ACTIVATED (soft/hard) -> ERROR/RETRY.

Devin: what does soft vs hard mean here?

Maya: soft = prefix-based activation with gating (limited sequence length / gated attention). hard = full verify before any non-trivial inference. hosted defaults to soft, dedicated/private default to hard.

Sara: adapters need to advertise caps: supports_index_first, zero_copy_ok, prefix_safe_bytes, requires_decrypt, critical_file.

Liam: mixed bundles?

Maya: treat as per-file subruns; state machine aggregates readiness and only marks ACTIVATED when all critical subunits are sufficiently verified (or soft-activated under policies).

Devin: eviction / interruptions?

Maya: introduce a resume_ledger token per warmup run with last_applied_chunk and epoch. eviction cancels liveness -> adapter Cancelled -> worker persists resume_ledger. resume_ttl applies; if expired we restart full ladder. retries bounded.

Sara: kvcache integration?

Maya: kvcache.accept_prefix(layer, offset, blob, resume_ledger) -> entries marked verified=false until chunk_verify completes. runtime checks kvcache.is_verified(layer) for long-context ops.

Liam: telemetry + ops surface?

Maya: emit tags: activation_mode, percent_verified, verify_ms_p50/p95, resume_retries, last_eviction_ts, adapter_name. console shows model-state (inactive / soft-active / hard-active) + resume_ledger_age.

infra-bot: canary note: branch warmup-ladder-2026 deployed to staging.

Devin: edgecases to track: encrypted shards (KMS handshake), transport stalls (retryable vs fatal), mixed criticality bundles, partial checksums. adapters should classify errors for backoff logic.

Sara: I'll prototype safetensors adapter with index-first fastpath and streaming-prefix test vectors this sprint.

Maya: I'll write short RFC with ladder diagram + adapter callbacks (probe/open_stream/prefix_apply/verify/finalize) and post by EOD. add anything else here. :rocket:
